assumptions.meaning: The inherited source_attestation locale assumes sound verification, a finite trusted roster, bounded Byzantine faults, a sufficient threshold and honest source-fact checks.
Every true non-Observed statement has one immutable stable statement at its source key. A later Finalized-to-Reversed change at that key is excluded; independent terminal consensus is not proved.
Caller identity, authority, permissions, regulatory metadata, versions and dependency footprints must describe the actual coherent current execution context.
Domain/asset allocation pools and immutable event keys must be related to actual source holdings and events. Token quantities are not regulatory holding support.
The modeled source endpoint atomically checks persistent debit absence and permanently fences the key; absence of an uncontrolled external observation is insufficient.
Accepted effect, marker and journal insertion are one atomic durable model step. Crashes between an external effect and its journal record are not covered.

Recovery uses the complete authentic locally produced journal and the same genesis allocation. Completed observations are retained separately, and historical policy evidence is not reconstructed in full.

The explicit cleanup call bounds require current permission, coherent versions, suitable evidence and calls executed while their lease/other preconditions hold. No unconditional evidence arrival, wall-clock bound or external-worker-workflow deadlock theorem is given.

All modeled routes must correspond to real entrypoints. Machine counters must not wrap, clocks must be authoritative and monotone, and the compiled consumer must preserve the actual guards and state updates. Runtime refinement remains planned.
